description: This file defines the EventHubSequenceToken class, which represents a token for tracking message position within an EventHub partition, including offset, sequence number, and event index. It also defines an interface for partition location.

classes.name: EventHubSequenceToken
classes.description: A serializable class representing a sequence token for EventHub messages, including offset, sequence number, and event index, inheriting from EventSequenceToken and implementing IEventHubPartitionLocation.

methods.name: EventHubSequenceToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing the token with offset, sequence number, and event index.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token, including offset, sequence number, and event index.
